paper_title: Bridging Cognition and Emotion Empathy-Driven Multimodal Misinformation   Detection
caption: Results of Ablation Study
model_annotation: This figure presents an ablation study comparing the accuracy of two models, PHEME and PolitiFact, under various conditions. The y-axis represents the accuracy as a percentage, ranging from 75.0% to 95.0% in increments of 2.5%. The x-axis lists the conditions: "Ours," "w/o comments," "w/o text," "w/o select," "w/o emotion," and "w/o cognition." For PHEME, the accuracy values are as follows: "Ours" at approximately 89.84%, "w/o comments" at 86.82%, "w/o text" at 80.10%, "w/o select" at 88.80%, "w/o emotion" at 87.34%, and "w/o cognition" at 87.17%. For PolitiFact, the values are: "Ours" at approximately 90.57%, "w/o comments" at 85.85%, "w/o text" at 83.02%, "w/o select" at 89.62%, "w/o emotion" at 84.91%, and "w/o cognition" at 87.74%. Each condition is represented by a distinct color, with "Ours" in maroon, "w/o comments" in orange, "w/o text" in yellow, "w/o select" in light blue, "w/o emotion" in blue, and "w/o cognition" in dark blue. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding.
